# cpanel_email_account_suspension (Resource)

Manages login, incoming-mail, and outgoing-mail suspension for an existing cPanel email account. Removing the resource unsuspends all three managed restrictions without deleting the mailbox or releasing held mail.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_email_account_suspension" "mailbox" {
  email              = "terraform@example.com"
  login_suspended    = false
  incoming_suspended = false
  outgoing_suspended = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The complete existing email account address.
- `incoming_suspended` (Boolean) Whether cPanel must reject incoming mail for the account.
- `login_suspended` (Boolean) Whether cPanel must suspend mailbox login.
- `outgoing_suspended` (Boolean) Whether cPanel must reject outgoing mail for the account.

### Read-Only

- `has_suspended` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports any suspension or outgoing-mail hold for the account.
- `outgoing_held` (Boolean) Whether outgoing mail is held in the Exim queue. This provider reports but does not manage held mail.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_email_account_suspension.mailbox terraform@example.com
```
